band_policy.method: Linear 25/50/75 percentiles; duplicate cut points collapsed
band_policy.intervals: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; last band unbounded

frozen_gates.sparse_slice_policy: Report sparse/unseen slices as unverified; no release claim
frozen_gates.zero_baseline_error_policy: Require zero model error; percentage undefined
frozen_gates.rationale: Provisional engineering gates: 5% useful improvement, full coverage, no >10% regression in sufficiently populated slices; absolute ceilings use validation baseline only

operational_policy: Retain frozen baseline/review policy; no model promotion, routing changes, or tuning against the consumed test set
interpretation: Historical submitted-price accuracy; no profit/award claim. Slice differences are descriptive, without significance estimates.
